comment: Generated by `npm run analyse:turnaround -- <id> --write`. Describes the DRAWING, posed — never a delivery target. scripts/v2/turnaround-spec.lint.test.js regenerates this and fails on any drift.

notTraceable.reason: 634px against a 712px standing view — every figure is scaled independently to 4ft, so a z read here is off by 11%. Silhouette and colour only.
the neck pinch landed on a search-window edge, so the head height is a boundary artifact and every percentage below it would be scaled by a number nobody measured
no distinct brow band survived the width guard on this sheet
no distinct eye band survived the width guard on this sheet

the darkest midline-crossing region (row 301, lum 29, 91.5% of head height) is wider than 0.5 of its row — a mouth merged with hair or shadow, whose extent this window cannot read — while the best bounded candidate (row 252, lum 45) is markedly lighter; trace the lip with a bounded probe instead of trusting the runner-up

rejected.why: as wide as the face at its own row — a fringe or a chin shadow, not a feature
